incident: TanStack, 2026-05-11: a project lockfile committed during the attack pins @tanstack/react-router 1.169.8, which declares the injected git optionalDependency

sources.facts: package-lock.json: the root entry and node_modules/@tanstack/react-router, verbatim; the other 661 entries dropped

gaps: no public package-lock.json pins 1.169.5: GitHub code search for the commit on 2026-09-26 found one package-lock.json, this one, which pins 1.169.8
the lockfile has no node for @tanstack/setup, only the edge in react-router's optionalDependencies
evidence is as of capture. npm removed the 1.169.8 version document and attestation, so its integrity, provenance, publisher and scripts read as unknown; a run at the commit time would have seen them
the lockfile integrity of 1.169.8 is the only recorded digest of that tarball, so it cannot be cross-checked
